title: Carousel Options
description: The Carousel molecule's presentation contract — slides per breakpoint and the four scroll affordances (packages/components/src/molecules/Carousel). Held here rather than inline because two content types render through the same molecule: the editorial carousel and, from v1.1, the product carousel (ADR-0020). One definition means the ninth option is one edit rather than two, and the two carousels cannot end up offering different controls.

slides-per-view.title: Slides per view
slides-per-view.description: How many slides are visible at once. Fractional values above 1 leave part of the next slide in view — a 'peek' that tells a touch user the track scrolls. Never below 1, which would make a slide wider than the track so no whole slide was ever visible.

gap.title: Gap (px)
gap.description: Space between slides. Defaults to the theme's --gap token when left empty.

show-arrows.title: Show arrows
show-arrows.description: Previous/next buttons overlaid on the track. Hidden automatically when everything already fits.

show-dots.title: Show dots
show-dots.description: Pagination dots beneath the track, one per scroll position. Hidden automatically when there is nowhere to scroll.

show-scrollbar.title: Show scrollbar
show-scrollbar.description: A styled scrollbar beneath the track. Worth turning on for a dense track with no arrows, where it becomes the visible sign that there is more to see.

drag-to-scroll.title: Drag to scroll
drag-to-scroll.description: Let a mouse drag the slides. Links inside slides still work — a drag is told apart from a click by distance. Touch is unaffected either way, since it already scrolls natively. Turn off for slides whose content wants the drag for itself, such as a map.

scroll-step.title: Arrow step
scroll-step.description: How far one arrow press moves the track: one slide at a time, or a full page of slides.
